about_the_game:
Tete’s Atelier is a Cozy Game where you transform shirts, jackets, eco bags, pants, sweaters, and more into personalized pieces. After customizing your clothes with patches, shapes, and colors, a special machine animation visually finalizes the process, highlighting the finishing touch. Then, you can sell your creations in your in-game store. Customers place bids on customizations, and each sale helps expand your creativity and collection in the atelier.

How Does the Gameplay Work?

👕Choose the Clothing/Accessory – Browse the menu and select a clothing or accessory model you want to transform. 🎨Use the color palette to add more style and personality to your clothes and accessories.

📐Apply Shapes – Choose from various decorative shapes and place them 

freely to create a unique and sophisticated design.

🐼Apply Patches – Select from dozens of exclusive patches and position them on your chosen piece.

🏬Sell in Your Store – Each piece receives bids from customers in the game. You can accept the best offer by clicking on the request or simply decline by leaving the store. Sometimes, there may be no bids available, encouraging you to explore new customizations.

🛒Earn Money and Expand – Use sales profits to purchase new patches, shapes, and clothes, allowing even more possibilities to express your creativity.

🌿✨ Transform Your Clothes into True Works of Art! ✨🌿

In our charming atelier, you’ll have access to a world of possibilities to personalize each piece with love and creativity.

Key Features

✅ 50+ Exclusive Patches – Unique embroidery to style up your clothes!
✂️ 50+ Decorative Shapes – Add a special and personalized touch to your designs.
🎨 30+ Vibrant and Soft Colors – Paint your clothes and shapes with love and creativity.
🏡 Customization Gallery – Review and admire all your creations anytime.
🛍️ Dynamic Virtual Store – Sell personalized pieces to customers who make unique offers.

With relaxing mechanics and a hand-drawn art style, Tete’s Atelier: Patches offers a cozy, creative, and charming experience, turning every clothing piece into a true work of art!
